sources.title: Understanding Success Criterion 2.5.8: Target Size (Minimum)
sources.quote: The size of the target for pointer inputs is at least 24 by 24 CSS pixels
sources.claim: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 sets a 24 by 24 CSS pixel minimum target size, subject to stated exceptions.

sources.title: Understanding Success Criterion 2.4.11: Focus Not Obscured (Minimum)
sources.quote: When a user interface component receives keyboard focus, the component is not entirely hidden due to author-created content.
sources.claim: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.4.11 requires keyboard-focused components not to be entirely hidden by author-created content.
